newsitem.title: USA: Fountain warrant exercise yields $18.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fountain warrant exercise yields $18.5 mln.

text.p: Fountain Oil Inc said through the December 31 redemption date, its holders had exercised a total of 3.08 million of the outstanding stock purchase warrants, and it had received $18.5 million in proceeds.
These warrants entitled registered holders to purchase shares of Fountain Oil's common stock at an exercise price of $6 per share, the company said.

As a result of the exercise, Fountain Oil said it received total proceeds of $18.5 million. With the issuance of another 3.08 million shares upon exercise of the warrants, Fountain said it now had 22.2 million shares outstanding.
